key.name: max-items
key.description: Oldest unpinned entries are dropped once the history exceeds this many items.

key.name: store-images
key.description: When off, only copied text is recorded; images placed on the clipboard are ignored. Explicit Area/Screen captures are always stored.

key.name: screenshots-dir
key.description: Folder to watch and to save captures into. Empty means the default ~/Pictures/Screenshots.

key.name: max-image-bytes
key.description: Copied images larger than this are not stored. 0 means unlimited. Does not affect Area/Screen captures.

key.name: entry-ttl-days
key.description: Unpinned entries older than this are dropped automatically. 0 means never expire.

key.name: encrypt-at-rest
key.description: Reserved for a future release; not yet implemented.

key.name: paused
key.description: When on, newly copied content is not recorded.

key.name: clipboard-helper-warned
key.description: Set once the missing xclip/wl-paste notification has been shown, so it is not repeated.

key.name: snippets
key.description: One JSON object per snippet: {id, keyword, label, body, uses}. Edited in the preferences window; the body may contain {date}, {time}, {clipboard}, {uuid} and {cursor} placeholders.

key.name: quicklinks
key.description: One JSON object per link: {id, keyword, name, url, uses}. A {query} token in the URL is replaced with the text typed after the keyword.

key.name: quicklinks-seeded
key.description: Set once the built-in quicklinks have been written, so deleting them all keeps them deleted.

key.name: search-url
key.description: Used by the "Search the web for…" result when no other source matched. {query} is replaced with the typed text.

key.name: emoji-recents
key.description: Most recent first, capped at 32. Used to break ties when ranking emoji search results.

key.name: currency-enabled
key.description: Off by default. When on, the calculator can convert between currencies, which requires fetching exchange rates over the network — the only part of this extension that makes a network request.

key.name: currency-api-url
key.description: Fetched at most twice a day, and only when a currency conversion is actually typed. Results are cached in ~/.local/share/omelette/rates.json.

key.name: sensors-enabled
key.description: Battery levels for connected Bluetooth devices, and fan speeds if this machine reports any. Both are read locally — BlueZ over the system bus and /sys/class/hwmon — so unlike currency conversion this reaches nothing off the machine, which is why it is on by default.

key.name: sensors-poll-seconds
key.summary: How often to re-read fan speeds
key.description: Seconds between fan readings, and only while the popup is open. Bluetooth batteries are not polled at all — BlueZ signals a change when there is one. Raise this if reading the fan wakes the CPU more than you would like.

key.name: awake
key.description: When on, an inhibitor is held against gnome-session so the screen does not blank and the machine does not suspend. This setting is the single source of truth for the feature: the popup toggle, the shortcut, the command bar and this window all write it, and one handler reconciles the inhibitor.

key.name: awake-until
key.summary: When to stop keeping the session awake
key.description: Absolute unix time in seconds, or 0 to keep going until switched off. Absolute rather than a remaining duration because locking the screen disables the extension and stops any timer, and timers do not advance across a suspend — a wall-clock deadline is still correct after either, so re-enabling simply compares it against the clock.

key.name: edit-after-capture
key.summary: Open the editor after a capture
key.description: When on, an Area or Screen capture opens in the annotation editor as well as landing in history and on the clipboard. Off by default: a window appearing after every capture is unwelcome if all you wanted was to paste it.

key.name: auto-paste
key.description: When on, activating a result also sends Ctrl+V to the window that had focus, so the content lands where you were working instead of only on the clipboard.

key.name: auto-paste-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to wait after the popup closes before sending Ctrl+V, so focus has returned to the target window. Raise this if pastes land in the wrong place.

key.name: paste-shortcut-terminals
key.description: Terminal emulators bind paste to Ctrl+Shift+V rather than Ctrl+V. When on, the focused window's class is matched against paste-shift-classes to decide which to send.

key.name: paste-shift-classes
key.summary: Window classes that paste with Ctrl+Shift+V
key.description: Matched case-insensitively against the focused window's WM_CLASS (app ID on Wayland). There is no way to ask a window what its paste binding is, so this list is the mechanism.

key.name: toggle-menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that toggles the omelette popup.

key.name: capture-area
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts an interactive area capture.

key.name: capture-full
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that captures the whole screen.

key.name: pick-color
key.summary: Pick a color from the screen
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that starts the screen color picker.

key.name: open-snippets
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the popup ready to search snippets.

key.name: open-emoji
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the popup ready to search emoji and symbols.

key.name: open-sensors
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the popup showing Bluetooth battery levels and fan speeds.

key.name: open-pdf
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the popup ready to pick a PDF and pull out a page or a range.

key.name: toggle-awake
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that turns Keep awake on or off.

key.name: open-editor
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the most recent screenshot in the annotation editor.

key.name: voce-hold
key.description: Hold this shortcut while speaking; release it to transcribe with the optional local Voce service.

key.name: voce-toggle
key.description: Start or stop dictation with the optional local Voce service.
